panels.title: k_model estimate per bucket (with CI bounds)
panels.description: Each series is one bucket (target/source/regime/epoch). estimate is the weighted log-median; ci_lo/ci_hi bound it (bootstrap 95%). Empty buckets carry no estimate and simply have no series here.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "sensors")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "k_model" and (r._field == "estimate" or r._field == "ci_lo" or r._field == "ci_hi"))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field", "target", "source", "regime", "epoch"])

panels.title: bucket status (latest round)
panels.description: The status decision table's verdict per bucket, latest compute round. unvalidated = not enough sessions (or an empty/new-epoch bucket); provisional = usable but not promoted (e0-legacy is capped here forever); stale = last reference pairing older than 90d; coverage = qualified ISO weeks in the last 90d / 13.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "sensors")
  |> range(start: -7d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "k_model")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "estimate" or r._field == "n_sessions" or r._field == "n_eff" or r._field == "coverage" or r._field == "last_ref_age_d" or r._field == "status" or r._field == "evidence_rev")
  |> last()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["target", "source", "regime", "epoch"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> keep(columns: ["target", "source", "regime", "epoch", "estimate", "n_sessions", "n_eff", "coverage", "last_ref_age_d", "status", "evidence_rev"])
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["target", "source", "regime", "epoch"])

panels.title: k_adopted vs k_model — the brake at a glance
panels.description: What consumers read (k_adopted.value) against what the estimator currently says (k_model.estimate). adoption_state=held means the value is FROZEN and pending_* carries the challenger — release with broker/ack-k-hold.sh --evidence-rev <rev> --accept|--reject. delta_pct is the challenger's distance from the adopted value (the ±10% brake band).

targets.query:
import "join"
m = from(bucket: "sensors")
  |> range(start: -7d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "k_model" and (r._field == "estimate" or r._field == "status"))
  |> last()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["target", "source", "regime", "epoch"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
a = from(bucket: "sensors")
  |> range(start: 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "k_adopted")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value" or r._field == "adoption_state" or r._field == "reason" or r._field == "pending_value" or r._field == "pending_evidence_rev" or r._field == "hold_ack_state")
  |> last()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["target", "source", "regime", "epoch"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
join.left(left: a, right: m,
  on: (l, r) => l.target == r.target and l.source == r.source and l.regime == r.regime and l.epoch == r.epoch,
  as: (l, r) => ({ target: l.target, source: l.source, regime: l.regime, epoch: l.epoch,
    adopted_value: l.value, adoption_state: l.adoption_state, reason: l.reason,
    pending_value: l.pending_value, pending_evidence_rev: l.pending_evidence_rev,
    hold_ack_state: l.hold_ack_state, model_estimate: r.estimate, model_status: r.status,
    delta_pct: if exists r.estimate and l.value > 0.0 then (r.estimate / l.value - 1.0) * 100.0 else 0.0 }))
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["target", "source", "regime"])
